frame_time_quantization: Normal1x12fps ceiling; exact original endpoint in last frame, no interpolation. GIF centisecond rounding separate. Inherited canonical1xslowmotion footer is factor1 normalplayback.

original_inertia_metadata.scope: Approximate retained native6-arm-DOF M_aa with fingers at actual configuration; downstream finger rigid inertia included, independent finger acceleration/coupled contacts not inverted. Five instantaneous WORLD acceleration projections, no axial inversion/position/lead row. Active only CLOSED head feedback with axial force-float; disabled during pickup/transport/OPEN/regrasp.
original_inertia_metadata.command_velocity_timing: Separate arm qvel copy captured immediately before previous mj_step coheres with retained M/J/Jdot/cvel/bias. Right PD damping and native drag use this copy in all phases. First command uses normal initialized fresh state, no qvel overwrite. Left/base controller unchanged.
original_inertia_metadata.desired_acceleration_scope: Independent head clock alpha and orbital acceleration -alpha cross lever-omega cross(omega cross lever). Current hole basis frozen instantaneously; hole acceleration and measured calibration derivatives omitted. No groove/pitch input.
original_inertia_metadata.caps: Total PD+FF with axial feed inside original8N/2Nm before mapping; bias and drag once, then unchanged native motor clips.

numerical_condition_limits.scope: Finite/SPD/full-rank rejection, no regularization; numerical SI bounds, not physical singularity certificate.
